quotes.text: Most of us assume the hard part of AI is making it smarter, but the harder problem is keeping track of what it's allowed to do.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Reframes the core AI challenge from intelligence to control in one memorable line.

quotes.text: An agent is a piece of software that doesn't stop at an answer. It reads information, makes a decision, and then takes a real action inside the tools you already use every day.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A clear, beginner-friendly definition of what makes an AI agent different from a chatbot.

quotes.text: A control plane is the dashboard where you see and steer everything, not the engine that does the work.

quotes.text: The guiding principle is least privilege, which simply means an agent gets only the access it needs to do its job and nothing more.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

quotes.text: Guardrails aren't a fence around innovation. They're what let a company say yes to agents without losing sleep over it.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters

chapters.title: Agent identity with Entra Agent ID
Who needs it and what it costs

takeaways: Microsoft Agent 365 is a control plane that lets an organization see, govern and secure every AI agent it runs, on top of Entra, Defender, Purview and the Microsoft 365 admin center.
The Agent Registry and Entra Agent ID give every agent a listed entry, an owner and its own least-privilege identity, so unsanctioned agents can be quarantined or blocked.
Agent 365 is licensed per person rather than per agent, so anyone who uses or sponsors agents at work is part of the governance picture.
hook: AI agents are multiplying across companies faster than anyone can track them, often without an owner or a clear list. This episode explains Microsoft Agent 365 in plain language for beginners and business users, showing how it treats agents like employees with an identity, rules and real-time oversight. You will learn why agent sprawl matters and how much of it touches your own workday.
